en.headline: 21-year-old man found dead in Tai Hang flat after being discovered hanging
en.dek: Police said the mainland tenant was found by the flat owner on Wednesday evening at a unit on Sun Chun Street; a note was recovered at the scene.
body: A 21-year-old man from the mainland was found dead after hanging himself inside a rented flat in Tai Hang on Wednesday evening, police said.

Officers received a report from the flat owner at about 9:50pm. The man, surnamed Cheung and holding a two-way permit, was discovered in a unit at 39 Sun Chun Street. Firefighters cut him down but he was certified dead at the scene. Preliminary police inquiries indicated he had used a piece of clothing. A note was found at the premises. The cause of death is pending post-mortem examination.
No further details about the circumstances have been released. The case is being treated as a death investigation.

zh.headline: 大坑21歲內地男子單位內上吊亡 業主揭發
zh.dek: 警方表示，事主為持雙程證來港的張姓男子，周三晚上約九時五十分被業主在新村街39號單位發現，現場檢獲遺書。
body: 大坑新村街一間出租單位周三晚上發生命案。警方接獲業主報案，指一名21歲張姓內地男子在單位內上吊。
消防到場將男子解下，惟當場證實死亡。初步調查顯示，男子以一件衣物上吊，現場檢獲遺書。事主持雙程證到港，死因有待驗屍後確定。
案件由警方跟進調查，暫未有其他詳情公布。
